items.title: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
items.summary: Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.

items.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
items.summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion
items.summary: Binance says the attacker reportedly gained access through a compromised employee laptop, and about $3 billion has been frozen onchain. This post Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin to $1.6 Million: Bitwise Raises Its Long-Term Price Target

items.title: FutureBit Apollo Solo Miner Finds Bitcoin Block 973262, Earning 3.154 BTC
items.summary: A miner running FutureBit's Apollo Solo setup found Bitcoin block 973,262 on Oct. 26, collecting the full 3.154 BTC subsidy-plus-fees reward from 2,477 transactions. This post FutureBit Apollo Solo Miner Finds Bitcoin Block 973262, Earning 3.154 BTC first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

items.title: $11 Billion in Bitcoin Options Expire Tomorrow–Here's What It Means
items.summary: A third of Deribit's Bitcoin options settle Friday, a day after the Fed held rates with two officials voting to hike. Here's why that matters for Bitcoin's price.
